What's Included

Concrete deliverables — no vague promises.

Technical SEO Audit

Full site audit covering speed, crawlability, indexation, Core Web Vitals, and mobile usability.

Keyword Research & Mapping

High-intent, realistic keywords mapped to your actual pages — not just high-volume terms you'll never rank for.

On-Page Optimisation

Title tags, meta descriptions, headings, internal linking, and schema markup — correctly implemented.

Technical Fixes

Redirect chains, canonical errors, duplicate content, sitemap issues — identified and fixed.

Content Strategy

Blog topics and landing page recommendations mapped to keywords your customers are searching.

Monthly Ranking Reports

Keyword position tracking, organic traffic trends, and clear explanation of what changed and why.

How We Work

No black boxes. Here's exactly what happens after you start.

01
SEO Audit

Complete technical and on-page audit of your site. We find every issue hurting your rankings before we touch anything.

02
Strategy & Prioritisation

We prioritise fixes and opportunities by impact — quick wins first, long-term content strategy second.

03
Implementation

Technical fixes, on-page updates, schema, and content — implemented directly or handed to your team with clear instructions.

04
Monitor & Report

Monthly keyword ranking reports with traffic data, what moved, and what's next in the strategy.
